title: If member pop-ups stop going out, no member gets gym messages or trainer replies and nobody is told
what: Pop-ups on members' phones (a gym message, a trainer's reply, an approved pause or renewal) are sent by a job that runs every minute. When its Firebase key is missing or wrong, Firebase refuses it, or the run fails, it writes only a hidden log line. The outage watch checks the websites, the database and the nightly backup, but not this job, so every gym's members quietly stop getting pop-ups until a gym complains.
expected: A failed or switched-off pop-up run is noted where the outage watch can see it, and raises the same alert a failed backup does.
who: members of every gym, and you
how_often: whenever the sending key or Firebase fails
fix_line: Write a health line for each pop-up run and add it to the outage watch

title: When MettleUp's payment server has a fault, the member's Pay your gym card just disappears with no word and no note
what: Every failure of the payment server (a fault, an outage, a slow line) is read the same as payments not switched on, so the fees the desk asked the member to pay, and the pay button on a shop order, simply vanish. The member sees nothing to say why, and in the real app nothing is noted either, so a payment outage is invisible to the member, the gym and MettleUp.
expected: A real fault is told apart from not switched on: the member sees that paying is not working just now, and the failure is noted.
who: members of gyms that take payments in the app
how_often: whenever the payment server fails (feature behind a switch today)
fix_line: Answer not working now apart from switched off, show a short line, and note the failure

items.reason: No AI call in this area; Play billing is not called here (the Plus lock keeps the last known answer when the server cannot be read).
Gym tab data is in the nightly backup, restored row for row by the CI drill on every push and watched by the outage check; online payment records are the known gap.
Most gym tab reads log a kind; lost-connection and slow answers are never noted, and payment failures are noted only in test builds.

The gym message check runs as an Android background job and a push task, so it works with the screen off or the app closed; it is Android only. No heart rate, rest timer, workout clock or watch code in this area.
Proven by reading: an offline leave is kept and sent again on every start; a failed board push retries later and resends the whole list; the push address is saved again on every return to the app.
A failed join, check-in, order, gym message or pop-up run is caught and kept on the phone or in a hidden server log; only crashes reach MettleUp.
Crash reports and an outage watch (sites, database, backup, read log) exist; no alert for the pop-up job and no daily health line for the gym tab.

Joins, check-ins, orders and friend invites are rows on the gym server and so can be counted there; the phone counts nothing, so pop-up opens, offer and trainer-share use and the drop-off between find-my-gym and join are blind.
